classifiedFinding.title: collectReward is mempool-visible: searchers can sandwich a funding deposit to capture rewards intended for long-term stakers

classification.assetImpact: MEV searchers capture a slice of freshly-deposited rewards by sandwich-staking around the collectReward tx. Long-term stakers see depressed effective APY.
attackPath: 1. Yield-accumulator broadcasts collectReward(amount) to public mempool.
3. collectReward executes; rewardBalance and accStablePerShare grow.
4. MEV bot back-runs with claim() + withdraw, exiting with captured rewards.
classification.likelihood: high — standard MasterChef-style MEV pattern; bots actively monitor this signature

classifiedFinding.justification: Profile §8.10 explicitly calls this 'Standard MasterChef behaviour; document but acceptable'. Per C4 conventions, generic MEV/sandwich findings without a novel vulnerability primitive are QA. The V1 re-anchor (KI) amplifies this but the amplifier itself is acknowledged. Demote to Low/QA.
classifiedFinding.notes: Sanitizer hinted potential-medium. Classifier downgrades to Low because this is standard MEV against a permissionless reward distribution; remediation (private mempool / whitelist) is captured by DEDUP-008 (access control on collectReward).
